defectClass: Runtime CLI remedies without the resolved project root
scopeSentence: Every tracked UTF-8 source line under src/, across all extensions, evaluated against the published ordered JavaScript predicates.
falseNegativeProfile: Only tracked UTF-8 text under src/ across all extensions; untracked files, non-src files (including these artifacts), binary NUL bytes and invalid UTF-8 are outside this universe and encoding exclusions are reported.

This checks line syntax, current occurrence coverage, required replacement witnesses and historical count consistency; whole-tree coverage, pre-edit chronology, semantic classification and runtime dataflow remain reviewer judgment.
Historical source text is public src-only evidence; original whole-tree provenance remains private. Recorded SHAs are labels, never runtime Git lookups.

Other command variable names, multiline/escaped commands and generated source can evade these textual arms. cli-remedy, hook-adapter and project-init tests separately verify actual project resolution and shell-inert output.

s99-m02 renamed the command. The literal arm's pinned predicate still counts cmos-mcp lines; its residual names the command as cmos-mcp, reasonbook, @aquex/reasonbook@<version> run through npx, npm exec or npm x (with any flags and an optional --), ${remedyCommand()} or ${cliCommand()}, so another spelling of the command (another variable, a constant built elsewhere) evades it.
